public-ip-prefix-above-default.title: Public IP prefixes above 16 addresses need a quota request
public-ip-prefix-above-default.body: This estimate reserves a public IP prefix larger than 16 addresses. Learn says Microsoft-owned prefixes are limited to 16 addresses unless you request a networking quota increase, and the whole prefix counts against the regional public IP quota.

citation.source: Azure Public IP address prefix, Limitations
citation.quote: You can create a prefix of up to 16 IP addresses for Microsoft owned prefixes.

public-ip-basic-retired.title: Basic SKU public IPs were retired
public-ip-basic-retired.body: This estimate prices a Basic SKU public IP. Microsoft retired Basic SKU public IPs on 30 September 2025; new deployments must use Standard.

citation.source: Upgrade Basic Public IP Address to Standard SKU in Azure
citation.quote: On September 30, 2025, Basic SKU public IPs were retired.
